hits.title: Board of Directors | Xometry, Inc.
hits.snippet: Sanjeev Singh Sahni is the CEO of Xometry and was appointed to the company's Board of Directors in July 2026. Randy Altschuler is the Co-founder of Xometry and the Executive Chairman of the Board. A successful entrepreneur, Randy co-founded Xometry in 2013 and served as its CEO for its first 13 years. He transitioned to Executive Chairman in July 2026. Sanjeev Singh Sahni is the CEO of Xometry and was appointed to the company's Board of Directors in July 2026. Fabio Rosati has been a member of Xometry’s Board of Directors since December 2017 and was Chair of the Board from December 2023 through June 2026. Fabio is the Executive Chair of Snagajob, a marketplace platform for connecting businesses with hourly workers, where he previously served as Chair and Acting CEO. Lukas Biewald was appointed to Xometry’s Board of Directors in May 2026. He is a two-time founder and current SVP of AI Initiatives at CoreWeave, Inc. (NASDAQ: CRWV). He is the co-founder and former CEO of Weights & Biases, the AI developer platform acquired by CoreWeave in 2025.
